// CASE ts_worker_quotes_24 expect=fire
export async function run<T>(
	items: T[],
	width: number,
	operation: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	audit: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
) {
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				merge(
					"k0",
					"k1",
					"k2",
					"k3",
					"k4",
					"k5",
					"k6",
					"k7",
					"k8",
					"k9",
					"k10",
					"k11",
					"k12",
					"k13",
					"k14",
					"k15",
					"k16",
					"k17",
					"k18",
					"k19",
					"k20",
					"k21",
					"k22",
					"k23",
					await operation(items[index]),
					await audit(items[index]),
				);
			}
		}),
	);
}
